reply.title: Squashing with the Logistic Curve
reply.story: When modeling probabilities or population growth, we often need a function that maps any real number into a strict range between zero and one. The logistic curve provides this smooth transition, acting like a soft switch. By adjusting its steepness $k$ and midpoint $x_0$, we can control how rapidly the output rises from zero to one. Let us explore how these parameters shape the curve and its slope.
reply.cardDescription: Explore how the logistic function squashes any input into a $0$ to $1$ range. Adjust steepness and midpoint to see the curve change.
reply.instructions: Change the steepness and midpoint sliders to observe how the logistic curve shifts and bends.
